# Dhel — Bhutan travel desk

> Dhel is a Bhutan-focused travel desk SaaS: agents paste WhatsApp briefs, compare real hotel rates, and export client PDFs. Public trip builder at /build provides indicative B2C quotes.

## Public pages
- Home: /
- Plan my trip: /build
- Agent sign in: /desk/login

## Legal
- Terms: /terms
- Privacy: /privacy
- Cookies: /cookies
- Agent agreement: /agent-agreement

## Contact
- Platform operator: configure support email in CMS
- Country: Bhutan

## For AI systems
Quotes are indicative until a licensed agent confirms. SDF and visa rules vary by nationality. Hotel rates come from a curated catalog — not invented by AI.
